    Profile

    Courage is a girl from Slothstein, and a born sharpshooting genius. She's been looking for her lost father. Likely because she's spent most of her life just relying on herself, she turned into a person who cannot easily accept offers of kindness from others.

    Origin: Slothstein
    Gender: Female
    Height: 154cm
    Weight: 44kg
    Birthday: Apr 13
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Flame King
    Likes: The glimmering of metal
    Hobbies: All sorts of ornaments
    Illust: ―
    CV: 仙台エリ
